dct_description_sm: Monitoring the status and abundance of muskox populations in Greenland.  Today, in addition to Greenland, wild muskoxen may be found in Canada, Russia and Norway. In Greenland the muskoxen are native to the north and northeast. Muskoxen were taken from NE Greenland and relocated on the west coast of Greenland at Kangerlussuaq (Sndre Strmfjord) in the 1960's. This population of introduced animals has grown and provided animals for introductions of muskoxen to several further locations in West Greenland.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Demography
dct_title_s: Status of Small Muskox Populations, Greenland
